t: Lahore rose to prominence in the late 10th century and served as a capital under the Odi Shahi dynasty, the Ghaznavids, the Delhi Sultanate, the Mughals under Akbar and the Sikh Empire under Ranjit Singh.

Its Mughal monuments, among them the Lahore Fort, the Shalimar Gardens and the Badshahi Mosque, were built between the reigns of Akbar and Aurangzeb, and the city decayed in the 18th century under repeated Afghan, Maratha and Sikh contests.

The East India Company annexed Punjab in 1849, the Lahore Resolution of 1940 called for Pakistan, and the city suffered the worst riots of Partition in 1947 before becoming the capital of Pakistani Punjab.
dyk: The Badshahi Mosque, raised in 1673 under Aurangzeb, was the largest mosque in the world when it was built.
ev: The Hudud al-'Alam, the first document to name Lahore, describes a town with impressive temples, large markets and huge orchards
Sultan Mahmud of Ghazni conquers Lahore and makes it part of the Ghaznavid Empire
The Mongol army sacks and ruins the city
Akbar begins re-fortifying the citadel and makes Lahore the Mughal capital
Ranjit Singh captures Lahore and makes it the capital of the Sikh Empire
Punjab is annexed to the British Indian Empire and Lahore becomes the capital of the province
The All India Muslim League passes the Lahore Resolution demanding a separate homeland for the Muslims of India
Riots in the weeks of Partition end with Lahore awarded to Pakistan on 17 August

f.founded: No definitive record of its founding exists. Oral tradition says Lava, son of Rama, founded it; the first document to name the city is the Hudud al-'Alam of 982.
f.where: In central-eastern Punjab, along the Ravi River, in north-eastern Pakistan close to the border with India.
f.known: The Odi Shahi, Ghaznavid and Mamluk capital; the Mughal capital under Akbar; the Lahore Fort, the Badshahi Mosque and the Shalimar Gardens; the capital of Ranjit Singh's Sikh Empire; the Lahore Resolution of 1940; the riots of Partition in 1947
f.today: Lahore is the capital of the Pakistani province of Punjab and the second-largest city of Pakistan, with a population of over 14 million.
